quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger?

options.text: The group will exit at the next ramp.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, all riders should move into a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If your left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, you are telling others that you plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to danger ahead. This sign tells you that a school zone is coming. You should slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not permitted. U-turns are forbidden where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road is crossing a divided highway.
You are driving over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road is crossing a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads split by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: From the center lane, what can you do?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or to drive straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is especially slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this sign. Get ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if needed.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. Come to a complete stop. Check for pedestrians and other traffic in the intersection. Wait until it is clear before going.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that another road is joining from the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
Go slowly through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only if there is traffic on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always stop completely. Only go when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to dangerous road conditions. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead curves right and then left.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns about conditions on or near the road.
Shows directions to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for dangerous road conditions. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a sharp turn is coming and you should slow down.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must go in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only go in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers rules they must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to dangerous road conditions. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction or maintenance work ahead. This sign tells you to prepare to slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will curve right and then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing where the tracks are at a steep angle. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond signs warn drivers of hazards. This sign tells you to drive carefully when the road is wet, as it may be slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road has many curves and bends. Slow down to navigate them safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The safe speed for a residential area.
The safe speed for a highway exit.
The safe speed for a highway entrance.
The safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for a highway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for exiting a highway. The number indicates the recommended maximum speed in miles per hour.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are coming to:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a HOV (high occupancy vehicle) lane. It is reserved for buses and cars with the driver plus a certain number of passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at low speed and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and keep more distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead.

questions.question: When an operator's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the operator:
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent upward at the elbow, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders behind should slow down.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must or must not do. It means parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What is the main danger when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
A tire may be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your vehicle may hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a merge ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that an area with low clearance is ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to show no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop completely, then go when safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show turns and stops. When the left arm extends straight out to the left, it means you plan to turn left or move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Move to another lane if safe to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane if safe to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room if you can. If no one is in the next lane, move over to let traffic enter safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign points in the direction of the sharp curve. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. More signs like this may appear along the curve.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign orders drivers to obey its rules. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital is to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign orders drivers to follow its rules. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Be careful and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to communicate when riding in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm up and swings it upward, it tells other riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be entering the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the road divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let other traffic go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be prepared to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to communicate when riding in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it tells the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a train crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws that all drivers must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always give pedestrians the right-of-way in crosswalks. Stay alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead only allows one-way traffic.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and look for other traffic before proceeding. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay to the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted where the sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you should keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green is on the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you of hazards. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down and drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed. You must obey this rule wherever you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. Do not turn around where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a full stop and check for vehicles and pedestrians before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you of a side road ahead. Be ready for traffic entering from that side road.

questions.question: When a driver extends their left arm straight to the left, what does it mean?

options.text: The driver plans to turn left.
The driver is about to stop.
The driver plans to turn right.
The driver is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver plans to turn left.
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm extended straight to the left means the driver is turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an intersection ahead. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross the road. Drive slowly and watch for bicycles in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane is ending. Drivers in the right lane must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells drivers to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop to let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming and you must prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that drivers cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. In bad weather or poor road conditions, you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.
